title: File:CKunalan-SingaporeOlympicAcademyYouthSession-20081103-01.jpg
depicts: C. Kunalan, aged 66, speaking at a Singapore Olympic Academy youth session
note: Taken 3 Nov 2008 (EXIF). Flickr source https://www.flickr.com/photos/whyohgee/3475966524/. Modest resolution; face clear enough to trace. The only openly licensed photos of him found are from this one 2008 session.

title: File:CKunalan-SingaporeOlympicAcademyYouthSession-20081103-02.jpg
depicts: C. Kunalan at the same 2008 Singapore Olympic Academy youth session, second frame
note: Taken 3 Nov 2008, nine minutes after -01. Flickr https://www.flickr.com/photos/whyohgee/3475967718/. Use as an inset or alternate.

title: File:C. Kunalan, 2008 (cropped).jpg
depicts: Head-and-shoulders crop of the 2008 youth-session photo (Wikipedia infobox image)
note: Crop of -01; low-res (398x531). Fine for a small portrait or frontispiece trace, not a full plate.

title: File:Estadio Olímpico Universitario, az olimpia megnyitóünnepsége. Fortepan 73823.jpg
depicts: Opening ceremony of the 1968 Mexico City Olympics at the Estadio Olímpico Universitario, balloons rising over the stands
note: Real October 1968 colour photo of the stadium where he ran 10.38 s. Kunalan is not identifiable in it; caption as 'Mexico City, October 1968'.

title: File:National Stadium, Singapore 7, May 07.JPG
depicts: The old National Stadium at Kallang (1973-2007) in its final month
note: Multi-licensed GFDL / CC BY-SA 3.0 / 2.5 / 2.0 / 1.0; CC BY-SA 3.0 chosen. EXIF 23 May 2007, weeks before the farewell where he lit its cauldron for the last time. The stadium he opened in 1973.

title: File:Gopuram of Sri Mariamman Temple Singapore 1.jpg
depicts: The gopuram (entrance tower) of Sri Mariamman Temple, Chinatown, where the couple's Hindu wedding was held on 17 April 1966
note: Modern photo (Jan 2026) of a building that stood in 1966; caption with today's date, not 1966.
